sentences.text: Louise Simonson -LRB- born Mary Louise Alexander ; born September 26 , 1946 -RRB- is an American comic book writer and editor .	American	Americans	comic book	comic book

She is best known for her work on comic book titles such as Power Pack , X-Factor , New Mutants , Superman : The Man of Steel , and Steel .	New Mutants	New Mutants	Power Pack	Power Pack	Steel	Steel (John Henry Irons)	X-Factor	X-Factor (comics)	comic book	comic book
